clauses.text:
Section 18: It shall be unlawful to drive or operate a vehicle over the streets
, J ,VV and roads of the Canal Zone outside of town or village limits at a speed exceeding
twenty-ive (25) miles per hour, or at a speed excedn eighteen (18) miles per hour
when traveling over the streets or roads of any town or village of the Canal Zone;
s ovided that, (a) on curves and ,jntertons of any streets or roads, or (b) when
approaching any location or apparent situation which might create a hazard to
vehicle driven or operated or any other vehicle or person, or (c) when passing other
vehicles, speed of all vehicles operated on streets or roads of the Canal Zone shall
he so controlled as to avoid accident or injury. The intent of this Order is that,
in addition to keeping within the speed limits, due e and caution shall be
exercised in all situations to guard against accidents, and failure so to do shall be
a violation of this Order.
The owner of a vehicle, if hiding therein or thereon, shall be held jointly
responsible with the person operating such vehicle for its speed and operation,
agably to the provisions of this Section. In the absence of the owner, the person
actually operating the vehicle shall be held responsible.
CALVIN COOLIDGE
Tnu Wanu loss,
September *9, 19.
(No. 47291
